messages.en: Your little brother's performance just now was really amazing!
Thanks! He's only ten, but he can already play the piano really well.

senses.en_definition: To impart knowledge or skills to someone, or show someone how to do something.
To guide someone towards good behaviour through advice or instruction.
Of an experience or event: to lead someone to learn how to act or what to avoid.

collocations.en: life's hardships teach a person to be self-reliant

senses.en_definition: To scold or punish someone to deter them from repeating an offence.

collocations.en: teach him a lesson so he won't do it again
teach that naughty child a lesson

messages.en: Can you show me how to use this app? I've tried, but I can't find where to upload files.
Sure. I'll show you during our break. Are you using your phone or a laptop?
My phone. Thanks! I'll try doing it myself then, and you can check if I'm doing it right.
Have you sent that file yet? The boss is waiting.
Not yet. I admit it—I forgot earlier. I'll send it now, okay?
You've beaten the club champion already?
Yeah, but only just. He's really good.
